items.title: Eat Dog Food
items.detail: Collect canned dog food from a Weenie Wagon or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Build a Heavy Cryo Turret in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Unlocked at rank 65 of Season 12 scoreboard; place from defense category.

items.title: Collect a Teapot
items.detail: Palace of the Winding Path has several on tables in the main building.

items.title: Kill a Wendigo
items.detail: Vault 51 has reliable Wendigo spawns; head to the Atrium then north through dining area.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Forest Region
items.detail: Point Pleasant has a dense concentration of cultists.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Kill Ticks at Big B's Rest Stop or scrap cleaner, solvent, turpentine, or tick blood sacs.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Radscorpion
items.detail: Find Burning Radscorpions at Little League Field in Hocking Hills or at Sinkhole Solutions event.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors such as train station robots.

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight Garden Gnomes are in the walled garden and shed at The General's Steakhouse in the Mire.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete five Daily Operations.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town's Bounty Board in The Last Resort saloon, then find and eliminate the assigned outlaw.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons for quick kills.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations like Silva Homestead or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Wear any outfit, hat or mask with 'Costume' in the description; Phantoms appear near cabins and campgrounds.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park in Toxic Valley has many Scorched; target the head for weak spot.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft and scrap Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench, or scrap relevant junk.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Encounter spooky variants of Scorched creatures with themed rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points during this weekend event.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this special weekend.
